CITY OF ALHAMBRA HISTORIC PRESERVATION COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  May 28, 2025

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  6:00 P.M. in Reese Hall, Alhambra Civic Center Library,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Chen, Littlefield, Ng, Michelson, Amaro

  Absent:  None

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director of Community Development; Maia
  McCurley, Principal Planner; Karabeth Garcia, Executive Assistant; Greg
  Murphy, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Amaro

D.  ELECTION OF OFFICERS FOR 2025-2026: Nomination and election of President, Vice-
  President and Secretary of the Historic Preservation Commission for 2025-2026, in accordance
  with AMC 2.41.060.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to elect the Director of Community Development as
  Secretary of the Historic Preservation Commission.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ng, Seconded by Commissioner
  Littlefield.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Chen, Littlefield, Ng, Michelson, Amaro
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  None

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to elect Joyce Amaro as President of the Historic
  Preservation Commission.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ng, Seconded by Commissioner
  Michelson.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Chen, Littlefield, Ng, Michelson, Amaro
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  None

  1
  5/28/2025
   MOTION:
  •  Moved to elect Dylan Littlefield as Vice President of the Historic
  Preservation Commission.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ng, Seconded by Commissioner Chen.

  •  Moved to have discussion.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Michelson. Motion was not seconded.
  Motion died.

  •  The first motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-1-0
  Ayes:  Chen, Littlefield, Ng, Amaro
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  Michelson
  Absent:  None

E.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – FEBRUARY 26, 2025
  •  Request: This is a request for the Historic Preservation
  Commission to approve the Minutes of the February 26, 2025,
  Regular Meeting of the Alhambra Historic Preservation
  Committee.
  •  Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the February 26, 2025, Regular Meeting
  of the Alhambra Historic Preservation Commission.
  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Vice President Littlefield, Seconded by Commissioner
  Chen.
  •  Commissioner Michelson requested to amend the motion to
  include a revision incorporating additional language in the Minutes
  on Page 2, Agenda Item 2, to read as follows: “Moved to appeal
  the Chair’s decision to move on without allowing for questions by
  the Commissioners.” Amendment was accepted, moving to
  approve Consent Agenda Item 1 as revised.
  •  The amended motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Chen, Ng, Michelson, Littlefield, Amaro
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  None

F.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  There were no discussion items.

  2
  5/28/2025
 G.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  ZONING  TEXT  AMENDMENT  AMD-25-03  (HISTORIC
  PRESERVATION ORDINANCE)
  • Citywide
  • Applicant: City of Alhambra
  • This is a City-initiated application for Zoning Text Amendment
  AMD-25-03 to adopt a Historic Preservation Ordinance
  establishing regulations and standards for designating historic
  resources within the City and regulating designated resources as
  part of a comprehensive Historic Preservation Program, as well
  as amending various sections of the Alhambra Municipal Code to
  establish consistency with the proposed Historic Preservation
  Ordinance.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 25-01
  recommending that the Planning Commission and City Council
  adopt Zoning Text Amendment AMD-25-03, a Historic
  Preservation Ordinance establishing regulations and standards
  for designating historic resources within the City and regulating
  designated resources as part of a comprehensive Historic
  Preservation Program.
  •  Principal Planner Maia McCurley provided the Staff
  presentation.
  •  The City’s consultant, Historic Resources Group (HRG), and
  sub-consultant, Architectural Resources Group (ARG),
  provided the presentation.
  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Jennifer Ng
  2.) Lewis McCammon
  3.) Andrew Salimian (Los Angeles Conservancy)
  4.) Marisol Grier
  5.) Oscar Amaro (The Alhambra Preservation Group)
  6.) Jeanmarie Zimmerman
  7.) Thomas De La Torre
  8.) Prasant Desai
  9.) Mara Murphy

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to adopt Resolution No. 25-01 with a revision to the
  language in subparagraphs (b), (c), (d), and (h) of Section
  23.23.070(A)(4) by changing instances of the word “property” to
  “resource.”
  •  Moved by Vice President Littlefield, Seconded by Commissioner
  Michelson.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Chen, Ng, Michelson, Littlefield, Amaro
  3
  5/28/2025
   Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  None

H.  PUBLIC COMMENTS/ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  Oscar Amaro commented on a previous public comment that “opting out” will cost
  money. He inquired if there are associated fees upon opting out.
  •  Prasant Dasai commented that properties in the 2023 Historic Resources Survey
  would need to go through an HRA process before making alterations, and that
  there is a cost for HRAs. He also commented on how properties in districts require
  a  vote  while  those  outside  of  districts  do  not.

I.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:33 P.M. to
  Wednesday, June 25, 2025, at 6:00 P.M.
